description: NL2SQL 执行准确率评测集（P0-1）：每条用例以「问题 → golden SQL」标注，执行准确率 = 生成 SQL 与 golden SQL 的结果集一致（无序多重集比较；ordered=true 时按行序比较）。golden SQL 仅用基础表名（clients/visits/...），与 Schema name 字段一致。

cases.question: 一共有多少个客户？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM clients

cases.question: 各行业分别有多少个客户？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT industry, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM clients GROUP BY industry

cases.question: 各客户状态的客户数量分别是多少？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM clients GROUP BY status

cases.question: 各客户类型的数量是多少？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT clientType, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM clients GROUP BY clientType

cases.question: 一共有多少条客户拜访记录？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM visits

cases.question: 各拜访类型的拜访次数分别是多少？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM visits GROUP BY type

cases.question: 哪位拜访人的拜访次数最多？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT ownerName, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM visits GROUP BY ownerName ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: 重点客户有多少个？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM clients WHERE isKeyAccount = 1

cases.question: 各区域的客户数量分布是怎样的？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM clients GROUP BY region

cases.question: 一共有多少个部门？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM departments

cases.question: 启用状态的用户有多少个？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM users WHERE status = 'active'

cases.question: 各情感倾向的拜访记录分别有多少条？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT sentiment, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM visits GROUP BY sentiment

cases.question: 客户数量最多的三个行业是哪些？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT industry, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM clients GROUP BY industry ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 3

cases.question: 各团队分别有多少个客户？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT team, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM clients GROUP BY team

cases.question: 线下拜访一共有多少次？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM visits WHERE type = '线下拜访'

cases.question: 各拜访地点的拜访次数分别是多少？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT location, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM visits GROUP BY location
